podcast.body: 604 Records is a Vancouver-based record label owned by Chad Kroeger of Nickelback. "now that he has his own record label the Vancouver based 604 records..."

podcast.title: Thorneley Band Signing
podcast.body: Ian Thorneley's relationship with Chad Kroeger of Nickelback led to his signing with 604 Records out of Vancouver, marking the beginning of his band Thorneley. "His relationship with Chad Kruger of Nickelback led him deciding with 604 Records out of Vancouver."
